widgets.trending: The tracks trending on the catalog charts, one at a time. Request pulls a track into your library.
widgets.mixes: The playlists ListenBrainz builds from your scrobbles. Open one to see its tracks and request what you are missing.
widgets.artistsNext: Artists similar to the ones you play most that are not in your library, with their latest release. Without history, the top artists in your region.
widgets.genres: Catalog categories to browse. Open one to see its albums and editorial playlists.
widgets.topTracks: Your most scrobbled tracks on Last.fm, all time.
widgets.scrobbles: Your latest Last.fm scrobbles as they arrive, newest first.
widgets.requests: What you requested most recently, with how far each one got.
widgets.onRepeat: Your most played tracks of the last 30 days as one set. Play replaces the queue with them.
widgets.rewind: Tracks you played a lot 6 to 12 months ago and have not played in the last 30 days. Play replaces the queue with them.
widgets.deepCuts: Tracks you own by your most played artists that you have never played. Play replaces the queue with them.
widgets.forgottenFavorites: Favorites you have not played in 90 days or more. Play replaces the queue with them.
widgets.jumpBackIn: Albums you started in the last 7 days and did not finish. Play starts the album again.
widgets.lastYear: What you played this same week one year ago, from your own play history.
widgets.stations: Radio stations seeded from your top artists, your favorites and the tracks you have never played.
widgets.continueListening: Your play queue where you left it, and your latest plays from every app.
widgets.rarities: Tracks you play that few people listen to, from ListenBrainz listen counts.
widgets.orbit: Albums you do not own, picked from tracks similar to the ones you play most.
widgets.charts: This week's top tracks in your region on Last.fm. Play the ones you have and request the rest.
widgets.loved: Tracks you loved on Last.fm that are not in your library yet.
widgets.newInLibrary: Albums that landed in the last 7 days, and whether you played them.
widgets.gaps: Releases missing from the artists you own most, compared with the catalog.
widgets.anniversaries: Albums in your library released around this date in past years.
widgets.landed: Albums downloaded in the last 7 days, with the source and how long they took.
widgets.serverPlaylists: Your latest playlists and the media servers they are synced to.
